issues.claim: g item 123 (canon: 'model: §2.6 (step 7: the damage layer over the same plan; the decay level read)') is absent: §2.6's plan rung step 7 still draws 'a `decayed` or `ruined` building its fallen walls and open rooms — a drawing of the same plan, nothing stored', uniformly, with no decay level, no per-element threshold, no progression and no restoration.
issues.required_change: §2.6 step 7, as new design at build depth (g item 123 (a), (b), (f)): 'A building's plan is derived once, as built (its built band and era), and never re-derived because it decays; a building first met abandoned, decayed or ruined (generated so, or by item 113's replay) gets its as-built plan. Ruin is a **damage layer** over that plan: each plan element (a wall run, a floor area, a door, a window, a stair, the roof bay over a room, a furniture piece) has one keyed threshold in [0, 1) (§6.3: by the building's lineage and the element's id; no new id), and the building's **decay level** (0–1, a reading of its existence state and the years since it was abandoned, V06; the material's rate V11's) shows every element whose threshold it has passed — monotone (a higher level's damage contains a lower's; nothing relocates); a restoration (`reused`, a repair) lowers the level and the damage leaves in reverse order, a repaired element drawn in patch material (item 114). Every room, wall, opening and id is unchanged and nothing is stored; a building never decayed draws byte-identically. Its drawing is V03 §5.1's and §8.6's, its battle-map walls §11.1's.'
